doc/adr.description: Architectural decision records, one numbered .adoc per settled decision. These are the durable rationale the skills cross-reference by ADR number rather than restating.

doc/concepts.description: Concept narratives explaining how each subsystem works — orchestration, verification, token management, process enforcement, build management and the rest. The explanatory layer that skills point at instead of duplicating.

doc/plans.description: The standalone cloud-lane plan corpus, grouped by epic. Each plan directory carries its plan, gaps, verification and dated run reports — the git-resident state the cloud lane uses because .plan/ is git-ignored.

doc/user.description: Operator-facing guides: installation, configuration, commands, recipes, efforts, and per-feature usage docs such as terminal-title and the enforcement hook. This is the published contract a skill's behaviour must match.

purpose_reasoning: The module contains only prose artifacts (.adoc and .md) and ships no executable or packaged unit, so it is a documentation surface rather than a library, extension, or deployment.
responsibility: The repository's prose documentation tree.
